[[Mobrin, Lord of the Marsh]] is a [[Tyrannus]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Sparkfly Swamp]].

== Locations ==
* [[Far Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Sparkfly Swamp}}

== Quests ==
* [[Mobrin, Lord of the Marsh (Zaishen quest)]]

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Crippling Slash}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Enraging Charge}}
* {{skill icon|Gash}}
* {{skill icon|Power Attack}}
* {{monster skill icon|Chomp}}
* {{monster skill icon|Stun Immunity}}
* {{monster skill icon|Sweeping Strikes}}
* {{monster skill icon|Twisting Jaws}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Mobrin's Blade]] ([[unique]])
* [[Saurian Bone]]

== Notes ==
* You can counter Mobrin's heavy damage with skills that cause [[weakness]] or [[blindness]].
* Compared to a regular [[Tyrannus]], Mobrin trades out the anti-block knockdown of [[Leviathan's Sweep]] for the cleaving potential of [[Sweeping Strikes]]. 

== Trivia ==
* Mobrin is possibly named after [[Mike O'Brien]], former president of [[ArenaNet]].
